doc: Values within 1 ulp .. 1e-4 of an exact tie, as float32: 128 + v / 0.5 is evaluated IN FLOAT32 (wind is float32), so a value a few 1e-6 above a tie is absorbed into the tie (the spacing of float32 near 128 is 1.5e-5) and rounds half-to-even, while a float64 evaluation would round it up: the same numbers in encode_wind.near_ties.f64 give different bytes. A port must add and round in the dtype of its input. Exact bytes.
